name: Nocturne QoL Suite (Recovery + Bench EXP + Sanctuary)
author: Nocturne
description: Configurable RPG Quality-of-Life suite across Koudelka, SH1, SH2: Covenant & SH3: FTNW: Post-Battle HP & MP recovery, cross-Quadrilogy Bench EXP Share, and optional Sanctuary Heal hotkey.

settings.label: Post-Battle HP Recovery %
settings.description: Automatically restore this % of Max HP to living heroes after every victory

settings.label: Post-Battle MP Recovery %
settings.description: Automatically restore this % of Max MP after every victory

settings.label: Bench EXP Share
settings.description: Keep benched party members synced with the highest party EXP after victories

settings.label: Enable Sanctuary Hotkey
settings.description: Allow pressing the configured hotkey in-game to heal the party

settings.label: Sanctuary Key
settings.description: Hotkey for on-demand Sanctuary party heal
